label: the first token of a continuation line inside a multi-line code comment block or docstring (the '#', ' *', ' %', '--' or indentation that opens the next line of comment prose); lines of code, SQL continuation lines, HTML and prose lists in the same files are silent

short: line-opening marker inside a comment block
notes: Card: max 14.38, density 0.068%, peaks '#' x4, ' :' x5 (:raises in a docstring), '   ' x3, ' @', ' *', ' -', ' ...' at the start of comment lines in license headers, docstrings and MATLAB '%' comments; the + pole peaks on the closing '"""\n' and '#\n'.
